findings.note: Smart, now a Rockets bench guard, made 1, 1, 2, 1 and 1 threes in his last five games, playing 17-23 minutes, so only one of the five would have cleared 1.5.
ESPN (Nov 12) says Smart served a three-game suspension and had made only one start in nine games while averaging 8.6 points; Udoka also mentioned a previously injured elbow.
In his one spot start on Nov 1, with Fred VanVleet resting, Smart made 7 of 10 threes in 36 minutes, so the bet depends on whether VanVleet plays; nothing found shows VanVleet's status for this game.
